item.title: IRON MAIDEN's BRUCE DICKINSON Tells Fans to Stop Asking For Another 'Number Of The Beast': 'That’s Not How Art Works'
item.description: Bruce Dickinson has a clear message for IRON MAIDEN fans who want the band to recreate its most famous album: it isn’t going to happen. Speaking in a recent interview (via The Charismatic Voice), the singer explained why requests for another “Number Of The Beast” miss the point of how music is made (transcribed by LOUDLEGENDS.

item.title: BRUCE DICKINSON Talks About Why IRON MAIDEN’s Sound Stops Him From Using 'Bone-Crushing Heaviness'
item.description: In a recent interview with Shaggy of the 94.9 and 104.5 The Pick radio station, IRON MAIDEN frontman Bruce Dickinson opened up about the deliberate “heavier” musical direction of his solo work compared to the band’s output.

item.title: Nicko McBrain Fires Back at IRON MAIDEN’s New Drummer, Declares ‘He’s Not Me’ and Says Band Can’t Replace 42 Years of History
item.description: Former Iron Maiden drummer Nicko McBrain is enjoying life after retirement, but he’s still got a few things to say, especially about the band he spent over four decades performing with.

item.title: Iron Maiden Breaks Silence On Ozzy Osbourne Passing After Fan Backlash
item.description: Iron Maiden has finally addressed the death of Ozzy Osbourne after fans criticized the band for staying silent. In a statement posted Wednesday (July 23), the British metal group offered condolences to Sharon Osbourne and the rest of Ozzy’s family, while acknowledging his role in shaping the genre.

item.title: Iron Maiden Faces Backlash Over Silence on Ozzy Osbourne’s Death
item.description: Iron Maiden is catching heat online after failing to publicly acknowledge the death of Ozzy Osbourne, who passed away on July 22, 2025, at the age of 76.

item.title: ANDI DERIS Says He Abandoned IRON MAIDEN After Paul Di’Anno Was Replaced by Bruce Dickinson
item.description: Andi Deris, longtime vocalist of Helloween, recently opened up about a personal turning point as a heavy metal fan. In a chat with the Scars and Guitars podcast, Deris explained how he reacted when Bruce Dickinson joined Iron Maiden in the early 1980s, replacing original frontman Paul Di’Anno.

item.title: Why IRON MAIDEN Turned To Japan Before Chasing The American Dream, According to ROD SMALLWOOD
item.description: Iron Maiden’s first real step onto the global stage came in 1981, the same year the band dropped Killers and hit the road for their first world tour.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Talks About IRON MAIDEN Drama: 'It’s Just The Singer I Can’t Stand'
item.description: Sharon Osbourne still hasn’t let it go. Two decades after the absolute circus that was Ozzfest 2005, she’s perfectly willing to laugh about sabotaging Iron Maiden with beans, pre-recorded sound effects, and strategic sound cuts.

item.title: IRON MAIDEN Fans Slam 50th Anniversary Tour: 'Most Predictable Setlist Possible'
item.description: Iron Maiden launched their Run for Your Lives 50th anniversary tour on May 27 in Budapest, Hungary. Grab Your Tickets Here. The show introduced Simon Dawson behind the drums, stepping in after Nicko McBrain retired in late 2024.
